preamble: No verified case of a direct /ʃ/ > /d͡ʒ/ sound change has been found. The file previously contained only a placeholder example ('Phonological Variation', family 'Various') with generic textbook citations that do not describe this change. Voicing and affrication of /ʃ/ would normally proceed through /ʒ/ (sh_to_zh) and then /ʒ/ > /d͡ʒ/ (zh_to_j_affricate), each documented in its own cell.
